title: fix(runtime): an anonymous /mcp caller is answered 401 ahead of the switch's 404 and the service's 501
body:
Fixes #24251

Clause-②: no

Basis for the Clause-② line: only the order of the refusals moves. An anonymous caller's `404` and `501` become the `401` that ADR-0138 D2 owes. No request that was refused before is accepted. No export moves: the new `refuseAnonymousMcpCaller` is module-private, and `handleMcpRequest`'s signature is unchanged.

## What changed

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` (the expected landing): `handleMcpRequest` now takes its anonymous decision as its first statement, ahead of `isMcpServerEnabled()` (`404`) and the `mcp` service check (`501`). The predicate is unchanged (`!ec || (!ec.userId && !ec.isSystem)`).
- A caller that the decision admits (a user or a system principal) still gets the `404` and then the `501`, in that order. The service guard keeps its exact text, `!mcp || typeof mcp.handleHttpRequest !== 'function'`. Two comments mirror that text, `/discovery`'s `hasMcp` in `http-dispatcher.ts` and the probe in `rest-server.ts`, and both stay true.
- The anonymous `401` is now built by the module-private `refuseAnonymousMcpCaller`. The status, the code, both messages and the `WWW-Authenticate` shape are the same as before. The one change is when it advertises resource metadata (next section).
- The producer is this handler on both hosts. `createHonoApp`'s catch-all and the standalone `/mcp` mounts both hand the request to `dispatch()`, and neither adds a gate on `/mcp`. So nothing outside `mcp.ts` needed to change.

## What the 401 advertises, now that it comes first

Before this change, the anonymous branch was reached only when the switch was on and a service was installed. Now it is reached in every composition, so its RFC 9728 `resource_metadata` advertisement needed a rule for the other two.

Measured on the real `AuthManager` (plugin-auth, `baseUrl: https://acme.example.com`). This was a throwaway probe, deleted after the run.

| `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED` | OIDC provider | `getMcpResourceMetadataUrl()` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| unset (on) | default (follows the switch) | `https://acme.example.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` |
| `false` | default | `null` |
| `false` | `OS_OIDC_PROVIDER_ENABLED=true` | the URL |
| `false` | config `oidcProvider: true` | the URL |

plugin-auth mounts `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` only when `readMcpServerEnabledEnv()` is true (`auth-plugin.ts`). With the switch off and OIDC forced on, the auth service therefore answers a URL that the deployment does not serve. With no `mcp` service installed, the document is mounted, but it describes a resource that would answer `501`.

**Chosen shape:** the `401` carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="ObjectStack MCP", resource_metadata="…"` only when three things hold:

1. the switch is on;
2. an `mcp` service can take the request;
3. the auth service answers a metadata URL.

The first two are the same predicate `/discovery` uses for `routes.mcp`. In every other composition the `401` is the plain API-key one. With the switch off, the `mcp` service is not resolved at all. The service lookup is `resolveService`, the capability probe that answers `undefined` rather than throwing, so an absent service cannot crash the refusal.

The header tells an anonymous caller nothing that the public `/discovery` route and the metadata document do not already tell it. The `401` status and `code` are the same in every composition.

## Measured before and after, on both hosts

Before means base `9822b053e`. After means `a3fba9c8a`. An anonymous `POST /api/v1/mcp` with a JSON-RPC body:

| Composition | Standalone, before | Standalone, after | `createHonoApp`, before | `createHonoApp`, after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| MCP on and installed | `401` | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` + `resource_metadata` | `401` | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` + `resource_metadata` |
| no `mcp` service | `501` | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, no `WWW-Authenticate` | `501` | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, no `WWW-Authenticate` |
| `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED=false` | `404` | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, no `WWW-Authenticate` | `404` | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, no `WWW-Authenticate` |

- On the standalone host, `GET` and `DELETE` gave the same readings as `POST`, before and after.
- Signed in, both hosts answer `200` from the transport, `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` and `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, before and after. That is the control.
- In the before run, the hosted door already gave the same answers as the standalone server, wrong answers included. The parity rows below stay green.

## Hold-offs confirmed, not widened

- `handleMcpSkillRequest` (`/mcp/skill`) still checks the switch first. It is served public on purpose, like `/discovery`. The anonymous-door sweep classifies it as an outside family with no `401` expectation (`anonymous-door-sweep.classification.ts`, `mcp-skill-document`). It has no anonymous decision to move, so D2's order does not reach it. Untouched.
- The signed-in `404` and `501` are unchanged and pinned as controls on both hosts.
- System principals still pass the anonymous decision as before. The only in-process entry is `HttpDispatcher.handleMcp`, reached from `dispatch()`'s domain routes. A repo-wide grep found no other caller. Unit pins check that a system principal still gets the switch-off `404`, the no-service `501`, and the transport.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-anonymous-first.hono.integration.test.ts` (new): the standalone composition (`LiteKernel` + `HonoServerPlugin` + the dispatcher plugin) over a real socket. Three compositions × `POST`/`GET`/`DELETE` anonymous → `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, and the transport is never reached. A row per composition for the `WWW-Authenticate` shape. The signed-in controls. The fake `auth` slot answers a metadata URL in every composition, as plugin-auth does with OIDC forced on.
- `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-mcp-anonymous-first.conformance.test.ts` (new): the same rows through `createHonoApp`'s own pipeline (`app.request`), plus parity with the standalone server (status, `code` and `WWW-Authenticate`), anonymous and signed in.
- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.mcp.test.ts`: unit pins for the anonymous `401` ahead of the `404` and the `501`, and the three system-principal controls.
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-body-after-anonymous-floor.hono.integration.test.ts`: a header comment said the anonymous decision followed the enabled and available checks. This change makes that comment false, so it is corrected. Comment only.

Every refusal pin asserts `status`, `error.code` and `error.httpStatus`. No message text is pinned.

Readings, in the order they were taken:

- At `b4159a3c3` (after merging `origin/main` `d537a318b`):
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: 418 files, 6583 passed, 19 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/http-conformance`: 17 files, 226 passed; `typecheck` OK.
  - `@objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 up to date.
  - `@objectstack/runtime` `typecheck` was red: the nine new unit reads grew the file's test-typecheck debt (TS18048).
- At `a3fba9c8a`, which fixes those reads with `!` and touches nothing else:
  - `@objectstack/runtime` `typecheck` OK;
  - `http-dispatcher.mcp.test.ts` plus the new integration file: 34 passed.

## Ablation (one-time, not kept)

Both mutations were landed with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit 1 → 0 and the blob changed. Each was rebuilt and proven in `dist/` with `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` (exit 0) before its run, because `http-conformance` reads `@objectstack/runtime` from `dist/`.

1. **Order.** The anonymous condition was guarded by `isMcpServerEnabled() && service present`, which restores the old answers.
   - runtime: 10 red, 24 green. The anonymous rows read `501` and `404`.
   - conformance: 2 red, 10 green, `expected 501 to be 401` and `expected 404 to be 401`.
2. **Advertisement gate.** `served` was forced true.
   - runtime: 2 red, 32 green.
   - conformance: 2 red, 10 green. In each, `WWW-Authenticate` read `Bearer realm="ObjectStack MCP", resou…` where `null` was expected, on the switch-off and no-service rows.

The direction matched the prediction both times. Restore leg:

- blob equal to HEAD `55cde0fd74e2`, and `git diff HEAD` empty;
- rebuild, then both markers `--absent` (exit 0) and the fix's marker present (exit 0);
- the reruns went green, 34 and 12 passed;
- `git status --porcelain` empty.

## Gates

Local subset, run at the final head `a3fba9c8a` (exit codes captured before any pipe):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 65 commands against merge base `d537a318b`. All 65 exited 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. In an earlier round, at `84585ac0e`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no workspace `dist/`). It measured once the closure was built.
- Roster families whose roster sits under a changed directory, each exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:route-ledger-census`.
- The lint family, which `dispatch-gates` does not name: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the five changed `.ts` files exited 0 with no output. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- The dogfood authz census (`authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`, `authz-conformance.test.ts`), because the Dogfood gate does not run on a PR: 2 files, 108 passed. The census controls on `mcp.ts` are unchanged from base: 2 `export async function handle…Request`, 1 `buildMcpBridge(deps, context)`, 4 `prefix: '/`. `refuseAnonymousMcpCaller` is not exported, so it does not join that population.

CI's families are read from this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- Docs, qualified in this PR (patch round 1, `63bf9f463`, on the seat's review `6248974571`): `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`'s switch-off callout and its `404` / `501` troubleshooting rows, and the `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED` row of `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`, now say what each caller sees. A caller with an API key or token gets the `404` / `501`. An anonymous caller (an OAuth client before it signs in included) gets a plain `401` with no `resource_metadata`. The first round had recorded these as `carrier: none`; a PR fixes published text it makes false, so they ride here.
- `handleMcpSkillRequest` keeps its switch-first order by design (above). Not a finding.
